description: Servicio de visualización WMS de riesgo por inundaciones is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by pcivil.icgc.cat. WMS service for visualization of the areas that, according to hydrological, hydraulic and geomorphological studies, could be affected by flooding due to rain or by dam breakage or failure. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "WMS view service of flood risk" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2026-04-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.icgc.cat/condicions). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
